race.comment: SIMPLY ROYALTY (2) stepped out to 1400m for the first time last start and ran over the top to score. That was an impressive win and the rating she produced there was strong. Wouldn't surprise to see her go on with the job now. ALOTTA FIGHTING (4) is knocking on the door of another win, flying home from the back of the pack. A better draw this time is a big bonus as he'll sit much closer in the run. Rates highly on his recent form and he can get the job done this time. SAINTY CULLITY (1) finished off nicely from the back of the pack last start, but that was over furtgher. Nottle remains on board and he returns back to 1400m where he's raced well previously. Can make an impression once again. LANTA (3) is on the cusp of a victory and can be in this for a long way. JUST SUBLIME (6) is better than she showed last start and can turn in a better effort this time.
